title: 第三章太白来投境界划分第四章炼精化炁融合祖炁
slug: 洪荒走向神话的大天尊
content_zh:
昊天正自苦恼间，忽见一道流光自太古星辰深处飞出，穿云破雾，须臾便至天庭之外。
那流光顿住，化作一位白发白须、仙风道骨的老者，恭恭敬敬立于南天门外，朗声道：
“启明星灵，求见大天尊。”
昊天闻言，心中大喜——人，这不就来了么！
旁人或许对天庭避之不及，但这些诞生于太古星辰之中的星灵而言，天庭恰恰是最好的归宿。
说到底，他们也没得选——本体星辰就在天庭的势力范围之内，不加入天庭，还能如何？难道投入别家势力，让天庭给他们穿小鞋么？
瑶池闻声，也瞬间移至昊天身侧，一双妙目望向殿外。
“进来吧。”昊天开口，声音虽淡，却自有天帝威仪。
话音方落，那位星灵便步入殿中，行至昊天面前，躬身下拜：
“小仙李长庚，参见天帝陛下！王母娘娘。”
来人白发如雪，长须垂胸，面容慈和，一副老好人之相。然其修为却是实打实的大罗金仙，与昊天、瑶池相较，丝毫不差。
细想便知，太白星主杀伐，位镇西方，统领金星之权。此人能自巫妖大战中存活下来，修为又岂会弱了？
昔年妖族纵横洪荒，布下周天星斗大阵，所借之力便是太古星辰。若无星灵默许，那大阵如何能成？如今巫妖俱衰，星灵们失了庇护，自然要另寻依凭。
至于李长庚这般和善模样，多半是为斩尸之故。太白星灵，秉杀伐之气而生，恶尸易斩，善尸却难上加难。故而化出这等慈眉善目之相，以养善念。
“道友不必多礼。”昊天微微一笑，问道，“不知道友此来，所为何事？”
李长庚拱手道：“陛下，小仙身为星灵，久在太古星辰修行，观洪荒动荡，生灵涂炭，心中不忍。今闻天庭初立，道祖亲敕，小仙愿投效天庭，为洪荒略尽绵薄之力。”
这番话说得恳切，然昊天心中雪亮，李长庚此举，自有其算计。
星灵之身系于星辰，天庭掌三界星辰运转，本就名正言顺。与其等日后天庭壮大，锦上添花，不如趁如今草创之际雪中送炭。
况且这位天帝虽初登大宝，背景却着实深厚，道祖鸿钧亲封，六圣亦不敢公然违逆。
纵使昊天做不了君临天下的真正主宰，其安危也断然无虞。毕竟，谁又会去挑衅道祖扶持之人呢？

对李长庚而言，此时加入天庭，实乃上佳之选。
昊天听罢，颔首笑道：“如此，当真求之不得。”
他略一沉吟，又道：“即日起，便封你为太白金星，辅佐朕统御三界，司掌凡间升迁考核、天庭宣达之责。”
李长庚再拜：“谢陛下隆恩！”
昊天点点头，话锋一转：“太白，如今天庭初立，百废待兴，最缺的便是人手。此事便交予你去办。你与人为善，多走动走动，广结善缘，于你斩却善尸亦有裨益。”
李长庚微微一怔，旋即苦笑，不想这位天帝竟一眼看穿了他的心思。不愧是道祖身边侍奉之人，果然洞察入微。
“是，小仙领旨。”他恭声应下。
找人而已，这点小事岂能推辞？那些背景深厚、修为高深的大能他请不动，但洪荒之大，散修无数，难道还寻不来几个肯为天庭效力的？
天庭再怎么说也是三界正统，道祖钦定。对那些无依无靠的散修而言，此处灵气充沛，灵根遍地，又有蟠桃这等天材地宝，实属难得的修行福地。只要诚意相邀，不愁无人来投。
昊天对此甚是满意，正要挥退二人，忽听身旁瑶池开口。
“陛下，你是不是忘了瑶姬？也该把她召回来了。”
昊天闻言，神色微动。
瑶姬，那是他的妹妹，一石同胞，真正意义上的至亲。
说来话长。昊天本体系混沌玉石，不知因何缘由，从本体上脱落了一块。那块玉石经年累月，渐生灵智，最终化形而出，便是瑶姬。
彼时鸿钧尚未成圣，三人同住玉京山，朝夕相伴。后来鸿钧证道成圣，将玉京山迁入混沌深处，瑶姬却未曾随行，而是留在了洪荒。
content_en:
Haotian was in distress when he suddenly saw a stream of light flying out from the depths of the ancient stars, breaking through the clouds and fog, and reaching the outside of the heaven in a moment.
The stream of light paused and turned into an old man with white hair and white beard, and an immortal spirit. He stood respectfully outside the Nantian Gate and said loudly:
"Venus Spirit, please see the Great Heavenly Lord."
When Haotian heard this, he was very happy - man, isn't this coming!
Others may avoid heaven, but for these star spirits born among the ancient stars, heaven is the best destination.
After all, they have no choice - the original stars are within the sphere of influence of Heaven. If they don't join Heaven, what else can they do? Should they invest in other forces and let Heaven put small shoes on them?
Hearing the sound, Yaochi also instantly moved to Haotian's side, looking out of the hall with a pair of wonderful eyes.
"Come in." Haotian spoke. Although his voice was weak, it had the majesty of the Emperor of Heaven.
As soon as he finished speaking, the star spirit walked into the palace, walked to Haotian, and bowed down:
"Little Immortal Li Changgeng, see His Majesty the Emperor of Heaven! The Queen Mother."
The person who came had white hair like snow, a long beard hanging down his chest, a kind face, and looked like a good old man. However, his cultivation level is that of a real Daluo Jinxian, which is no worse than Haotian and Yaochi.
If you think about it carefully, you will know that the Taibai Star is the master of killing and controls the west, commanding the power of Venus. If this person could survive the Lich War, how could his cultivation be weak?
In the past, the demon tribe roamed the vast wilderness and set up a star formation all over the sky, relying on the ancient stars for their power. Without the acquiescence of the Star Spirits, how could the formation be accomplished? Now that the lich is declining, the protoss have lost their protection and naturally have to find another source of support.
As for Li Changgeng's kind appearance, it was probably because he was beheading the corpse. The Taibai Star Spirit was born with the aura of killing and attacking. Evil corpses are easy to kill, but good corpses are even more difficult to kill. Therefore, the appearance of kind eyebrows and kind eyes is transformed to cultivate kind thoughts.
"Fellow Taoist, there is no need to be polite." Haotian smiled slightly and asked, "I wonder why my friend is here?"
Li Changgeng cupped his hands and said: "Your Majesty, the little immortal is a star spirit. He has been cultivating in the ancient stars for a long time. He has watched the turbulence of the ancient world and the devastation of all living beings. He can't bear it. Now that I heard that the Heavenly Court was first established and the Taoist ancestor personally ordered it, the little fairy is willing to serve the heavenly court and do his best for the great wilderness."
These words were spoken sincerely, but Haotian knew very well that Li Changgeng had his own agenda for this move.
The body of the star spirit is tied to the stars, and the heaven controls the movement of the stars in the three realms. This is justifiable. Instead of waiting for the heaven to grow in the future and add more beauty to the cake, it is better to take advantage of the time when it is just beginning.
Moreover, although this Heavenly Emperor has just ascended the throne, he has a profound background. Taoist Hongjun personally granted him the title, and the Six Saints did not dare to openly disobey him.
Even if Haotian cannot be the true master of the world, his safety is definitely not in danger. After all, who would provoke the people supported by Dao Ancestor?
For Li Changgeng, joining Tianting at this time is indeed the best choice.
After hearing this, Haotian nodded and said with a smile: "That's what I really want."
He pondered for a moment and then said: "From now on, I will grant you the title of Taibai Jinxing. You will assist me in governing the three realms. You will be in charge of promotion assessments in the mortal world and publicity in heaven."
Li Changgeng bowed again: "Thank you for your kindness, Your Majesty!"
Haotian nodded and changed the subject: "Taibai, now that the imperial court has just been established and everything is waiting to be renovated, the most lacking thing is manpower. I will leave this matter to you. You can be kind to others, move around more, and build good relationships. It will also be helpful for you to kill the good corpses."
Li Changgeng was slightly startled, then smiled bitterly, not expecting that the Emperor of Heaven could see through his thoughts at a glance. As expected of someone who serves around Dao Ancestor, he is indeed insightful.
"Yes, Xiaoxian accepts the order." He responded respectfully.
We are just looking for someone, how can we refuse such a trivial matter? He couldn't recruit those powerful people with profound backgrounds and advanced cultivation, but since the ancient times were so vast and there were countless casual cultivators, could it be that he couldn't find a few who were willing to serve the Heavenly Court?
No matter how you say it, the Heavenly Court is the orthodoxy of the Three Realms, approved by the Taoist Patriarch. For those scattered cultivators who are helpless, this place is full of spiritual energy, spiritual roots are everywhere, and there are such natural and earthly treasures as flat peaches. It is truly a rare blessing for cultivation.As long as you invite me sincerely, you don't have to worry about no one coming to vote.
Haotian was very satisfied with this, and was about to wave the two men away when he suddenly heard Yaochi beside him speak.
"Your Majesty, have you forgotten Yao Ji? It's time to bring her back."
When Haotian heard this, his expression moved slightly.
Yao Ji, that is his sister, a compatriot from Yishi, and a close relative in the true sense.
It’s a long story. A piece of Chaos Jade of Haotian's original system fell off from its body for unknown reasons. Over the years, that piece of jade gradually gained wisdom, and finally took the form of Yao Ji.
At that time, Hongjun had not yet become a saint, and the three of them lived together in Yujing Mountain, accompanying each other day and night. Later, Hongjun became a saint and moved Yujing Mountain into the depths of chaos, but Yao Ji did not accompany him, but stayed in the wilderness.
